newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 364-day T-bill yields average 31.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia 364-day T-bill yields average 31.77 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 364-day GKO discount treasury bills (series 23005) was 31.77 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Russian Central Bank said.
An issue of series 23004 bills maturing on April 8, 1998, the date closest to the maturity date of the new issue, closed at 76.59 to yield 31.78 percent on Tuesday.
Dealers had forecast the annualised average yield for the bills would be 31.34 to 33.37 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
Later on Wednesday the Finance Ministry will also auction four trillion roubles of an additional 707-day tranche of series 24011 two-year interest-bearing government bonds maturing March 1999.
The Finance Ministry is also repaying 246.86 billion roubles in interest on the two-year series 24009 OFZ interest-bearing government bond which matures in October 1998.
The ministry is repaying 6.91 trillion roubles in the series 22055 182-day T-bill issue which matures on Wednesday.
